title: Following each bar or following the groove

start: You will play with two bands, one after another. Give each one a full go; they may sound alike, and that is fine. Play each the same way.
You lead a band with your drums. The bass and keys follow you.
Play a groove for a few phrases (4 bars each), then change to a different one; add fills between grooves.
Try a few grooves: steady kicks on the beat, kicks that push ahead of the beat, a busy groove. Come back to one of them later.
No pads to press: just play. To rest, stop drumming; the band keeps playing. Do not press Stop in Live.
condition: A new band. Play the same way: a groove for a few phrases, then a different one, with fills between them.

questions.text: When I changed groove, the bass changed with me
